accepted_cases: a successful empty source list is EMPTY only with source_complete, snapshot_complete and complete true; login pages, 401/403/429, maintenance, timeout, missing pages and unknown JSON business states are never EMPTY
the same title with different source record ids keeps both records and reports POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_TITLE / SAME_TITLE_DIFFERENT_IDENTITY
a date-only value keeps date precision and is neither padded to midnight nor sorted as a timed value
a cursor continuation keeps the original query_time, checked_at and read window across midnight

availability cache is always rejected as live evidence; directory cache is bounded; history fallback requires allow_stale=true and stays HISTORICAL/incomplete; changing only checked_at invalidates the cache binding

parameter, account, page-size or snapshot-version changes after a cursor produce CURSOR_QUERY_MISMATCH or STALE_SNAPSHOT_TAKE_NEW_SNAPSHOT for account-bound services, learn queries and authenticated pages; expiry/eviction produces CURSOR_EXPIRED
cancelling an upstream second page keeps the first segment but marks the collection partial (complete=false, snapshot_complete=false)

unfamiliar school statuses keep UNKNOWN plus a non-reversible digest; exception text, URLs, hosts, private paths and sensitive URL parameters never enter public error or evidence fields; integer platform statuses map without losing known states
result envelopes and source evidence validate against the frozen JSON Schemas; the embedded error-code mirror matches error-classification-v1
limits: A result snapshot above max_bytes still raises the legacy explicit RESULT_TOO_LARGE_SELECT_NARROWER_SOURCE error instead of silently truncating; it never reports completeness.
cache_policy is delivered and used by catalog.py; queries.py does not attach a new persistent history cache. 4.3/5.1/5.4/6.2 should reuse the policy when they add history fallback.
Library semantic statuses such as NOT_OPEN and NEEDS_USER_ACTION remain in the legacy status field for compatibility; source_state maps them to UNKNOWN and 6.1 may publish a separate public status.
The MCP exception boundary still emits the legacy error shape; query envelopes already carry the classified error object and 6.1 should enrich the boundary.
Offline synthetic evidence only: no real campus login, read, booking, payment or submission was performed.
rollback: Restore the nine listed code/test paths plus the tests/test_queries.py identity fixture to 4d60e8b and delete tests/fixtures/query/. New fields are optional and old clients ignore them; the added directory cache fields are additive. Existing c1 cursors become invalid explicitly and are never re-fetched into a new snapshot.
